headline: The documented round-down rule plus the stated merchant exclusions reproduce the two gold disputes exactly; the only defect is that the rounding doc is missing from required_documents.

issues.summary: The floor-rounding policy doc that decides which transactions are discrepant (doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007) is not listed in required_documents, so the golden_retrieval config, which inlines only required_documents and exposes no search tool, never shows it to the agent.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
src/tau2/domains/banking_knowledge/retrieval_toolkits.py: KnowledgeToolsPlain 'Used by: no_knowledge, full_kb, golden_retrieval' (no retrieval tools)
issues.why_it_matters: In the golden_retrieval config, half-up rounding flags six extra transactions (ThredUp, HBO Max, Spotify, Tesla Supercharger, Patagonia 161.15, DTE Energy) and fails.

solution_check: Recomputed all 17 transactions for d2e5bc4124. Business Bronze is 1%, except 0% at WeWork/Regus/Industrious/payroll processors (business_bronze_003). EcoCard is 5x on Green, 1x otherwise, with ThredUp excluded and Tesla Supercharger a certified network (ecocard_004). Flooring per doc_007, exactly two mismatch, matching the gold: Chipotle 369 vs 184 and Everlane 1352 vs 270. The WeWork 0 and ThredUp 1x rows are correct, which matches the persona's 'legitimate policy differences'.
prior_note: The prior Major ('unwritten round down') is overturned: doc_007 documents floor rounding. What remains is a Minor required_documents omission.
notes: Verification uses DOB plus email, which the persona supplies; the gold log_verification copies the DB phone 718-555-0519. No discoverable agent tools are involved.
